This giant monster is a mother to the pests that plague the void knights. Big, squirmy, and covered in eyes and tentacles; it's best not to get too close!

Quest: The Void Stares Back

Combat: She spawns drones that, in turn, spawn defilers. You must keep the queen's helpers at bay so your fellow knights can stop the queen from healing herself. You need to use the special attack on Korasi's sword (provided in the arena) to stop the queen from obliterating the knights.
